12.title: Build a responsive pricing table
12.description: Recruiters skim portfolios fast — a clean pricing table shows you can turn a common real-world UI pattern into responsive, production-looking markup without a template. Today you're building one from scratch: three tiers, one highlighted as "most popular," fully responsive down to a 360px phone screen.
requirements: Three pricing tiers with a name, price, and feature list
One tier visually marked as "most popular"
Stacks into a single column below 480px width
Deployed link or a screen recording if you can't deploy today
